notes.title: VRacer major update! Cross play with Quest
notes.content:
Hello Racers!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update—now live on Steam! Last Thursday we launched on Quest 3, and new players have been tearing it up in multiplayer all weekend. Here’s what’s new:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/bdab2f1c1991ca9b85027d9d7b647d290b8a7769.png"]

Cross-Play with Meta Quest

Full cross-play support for online leaderboards, ghosts, and multiplayer.

Challenge a larger pool of racers or just hang out in shared lobbies.

As we are moving to cross platform, for compatibility reasons, you will have a new profile when launching the game and start fresh with the progression



Enhanced Multiplayer Experience

See other players in the multiplayer lobby and gesture at each other.

Easier entry into multiplayer: get notified whenever there’s action going on.

Temporary “mini-championship” leaderboards track your scores during each session.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/1e36bdce5a1bec7398e56ef4e6e9821b622b68fd.jpg"]

bHaptics Suit Integration

Full support for bHaptics suits for a deeper haptic experience.

Enter our V-Racer bHaptics Giveaway for a chance to win your own suit!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/25be94c86870576d5e8956d21f9da8f0dcdf444e.jpg"]

Long-Term Multi-Platform Support

We’ve overhauled much of our codebase to keep PCVR, Quest, and the upcoming PSVR2 versions in sync.

PCVR now runs on OpenXR for broader headset compatibility—plus a new controller calibration tool to support even more devices out of the box.



Quality-of-Life Upgrades

Redesigned lobby with dedicated rooms for the Garage and Progression, plus a new Showroom for in-game photos.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/afc547e6192144daf67b45b7e326a7d3e7f2fa1d.jpg"]

Streamlined onboarding and progression systems.

Introducing our beta Replay Editor—easily clip and share highlights from your best races.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/ee809e32fc98c9ddbb200c7a3d1b300c54c8c7cf.jpg"]

Hoverbikes

Each hoverbike now boasts its own distinct handling profile.

Introduced a brand-new bike L-04 Lockstar ( Rookie Series)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/0e9e3c260345d6d69f6ea7948a7fe3eaada433db.jpg"]

Track

The Neopolis circuit has been completely overhauled to showcase the city’s towering skyline.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/d25730c1f9e3282b143993ec0787667a879972fc.jpg"]

A few more things

XBOX controller support has caused problems in the past. In this version we moved to using thumbsticks if you don’t like leaning

If you prefer the older version for some reason, we are keeping it live on the beta channel, but it will not be maintained in the future. You will keep your older profile with your progression and skins



Discord is where it’s at if you want to meet other players: https://discord.gg/e8vqws8





What’s Next?

PCVR and Quest will continue to receive simultaneous updates.

A content and graphics upgrade is coming alongside the PSVR2 launch later this year—stay tuned!



Thank you for your ongoing support over the years. Strap on your helmet and get ready—the race goes on!




The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: Getting ready for the major update.
notes.content:
Hello racers,



We are very close to releasing a major update for the game. This update will contain all the stuff we developed for the Quest version launching on june 26. We will have a separate post to highlight what's new.



But before that, we need to verify that the game works with all XR controllers. We have tested with the following controllers:

Oculus Rift/Reift S controllers

Meta Quest2/3 controllers

HTC VIVE wands



If you have controllers not listed above and would like to help us validate them, please answer to this post. As we are now using OpenXR, most controllers should be supported in terms of triggers/thumbsticks/buttons, but we have seen that hand alignment may vary from one controller type to another. That's why we need you to make sure hands are properly aligned for you in the game.



To check that your controllers will work in the game, download this tool: VRacer Calibrator

This is an executable that you can launch on your PC with your headset plugged-in, and it will guide you through the two minutes process. For any questions related to controllers, please ask in this thread.



Thanks for your help!



The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: V-Racer Hoverbike – Update coming soon & Future Plans!
notes.content:
Hello Racers!
We know many of you have been wondering about the future of V-Racer Hoverbike, and we have some big news to share!

PC Version – Final Release & Crossplay!
After a long Early Access journey, we’re excited to announce that the PC version of V-Racer Hoverbike will soon transition to a full release! As part of this update, we are adding crossplay with Meta Quest players, bringing more competition and a bigger multiplayer community! (The game is launching on Quest this spring, maybe PSVR2 some day)

New Content Incoming!
We’re not stopping at crossplay—we have exciting new content on the way!
We have even more features in the works that we’ll reveal soon. Stay tuned for updates, and as always, thank you for your support!

Let us know in the comments what you’re most excited about!
See you on the track!

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE RELEASED
notes.content:
Hello racers,

The wait is over. The MEGA UPDATE is here!!!
And it features everything we've mentioned in previous posts:

- complete rework on the menu system to make it full 3D with finger touch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/cf08f064c27e58222a7fbba5cac02c815f412d31.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/f0e50ff88d990881e304fba98f3a53ea8f5d49c7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/1d43d8d1b8a33fa84dcc684279fc12296541a6c7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/06e6d0b7e3529c93a009a91aeeedd35665037ce2.jpg


- and a gazillion small improvements that bring the game to the level we envisioned when we started

Anyway, time for us to grab a beer and celebrate! Enjoy the game and let us know what you think!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: MEGA-UPDATE COMING THIS FALL
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/18cd31949a6074667224be8902fee4dc34f50216.jpg
Hello racers,

We just started alpha testing for a mega-update that will drop this fall.

After adding all those race tracks, we decided to focus on making the whole game more consistent and challenging to play. The update encompasses a lot of areas, but here are a few of the things it will include:
- a completely redesigned menu system with virtual hands and finger touch
- a livery editor that now lets you customize not only your bike, but also your suit and helmet
- a career mode with increasing difficulty across several championships
- all tracks reskinned in "Neon style", available in two new game modes
- improved multiplayer with a spectator mode suited for livecasting and e-sports events
- progression system with unlockables (including bike models, suits, helmets, liveries and more)

We'll give you more details as we get closer to release.
In the mean time, have fun racing!

The VertexBreakers team

notes.content:
30 RACES MILESTONE!

Hello racers! We've been quiet for a while, but we are happy to announce that we just pushed an update that contains 7 new races, bringing the total to 30! Along with the new Zakhar Frontier track, we've taken the time to make reverse versions of all the HGP tracks.

We only had 4 races when we first launched in early access. We'd like to thank you all for your great support! Now that we have all those races, we can focus on what's coming next. We've teased the Neon tracks a while back, rest assured they are coming: you will get all 30 races in a new game mode with those neon style visuals. We're also looking at the career mode, and a few other surprises for the future.

In the mean time, have fun racing, and thanks again for supporting us!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: Back to school...
notes.content:
Hello racers,

We just wanted to give you a little update on what we've been up to during the summer. After releasing the game on Oculus Home for our friends with Rift/Rift S headsets, we took a little time off to recharge, and then we focused on the following things:

Neon Tracks
We're reskinning all existing tracks in neon style, for a new game mode that will let you race through gates, and shoot drones that try to slow you down with mines. Here's a couple of in-progress screenshots:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/57d57abd85a94a4eb03b03e13de53d86809c2840.jpg
.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/857f1c34e47ff3cb74679c9ad6d3848a7e11ad6b.jpg

Here's an early test video we did in spring, if you haven't seen it yet: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nnW-wKtiVMI

Telemetry
We've partnered with a couple of hardware vendors to explore how we could hook up the game with motorbikes for arcades. We'll tell you a bit more about that in september. The goal for us is to provide an API for anyone in the DIY scene who wants to read telemetry data from the game to drive external devices, like a fan, a buttkicker or even a bike on hydraulic cylinders.

New Zakhar track
We have a new Zakhar track currently in internal test. We expect to release it in september to keep you busy. Here's a couple of screenshots...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/ce75b7c48b1426885967649be31d251e40200212.jpg
.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/40ea79ebc608a04ee3c645351cb1f2f1f5fbc1b2.jpg

Career mode and bike customization
We've laid the fundation for the career mode. We feel that the game currently lacks a sense of purpose, so we want to provide you with a progression system where you participate in championships to unlock bike parts and improve your vehicle's racing capabilities. Still a bit early to show you how that looks, but we felt we should tell you it's coming.

V-Racer Hoverbike on mobile VR?
With all the hype around Oculus Quest, we've had a lot of you asking if V-Racer would ever make it to a stand-alone VR headset. It's not a easy feat to port the game as it is to lower spec hardware but we always like to push limits, so we figured we'd spend some time to see if we could even get it to run at all on Quest. We still haven't decided whether we'd fully go down that path, but we did create a prototype that got us excited. We had to remove all the post process fx, and cut down the textures and geometry quite a bit, so it obviously doesn't look as good as on PCVR, but we're excited to see that we can keep the core gameplay and provide a cool experience on Quest, with potential for cross play with PCVR racers.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/0713eae00b615995b7b185726993aa5332527de6.jpg
Before we move on with this idea, we want to take time to test it internally with a few players. One key aspect that we haven't validated yet is whether a 72Hz framerate is high enough for such a fast game, so we want to see if people get any motion sickness with that lowered frequency (we're running at 90Hz on Rift/Vive/WMR). Also, we still haven't pitched the idea to Oculus, so it's not entirely in our hands whether this will eventually happen or not. Let us know what you think about a Quest port in the comments.

Have fun racing, we'll keep you posted!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: LIVERIES – REAH – PHOTO MODE – MULTIPLAYER TEST
notes.content:
Hello racers, here is another update to the game!

LIVERIES
We've updated the liveries for all bikes. They were created with the livery editor that we are still testing and plan to integrate in the game so you can go wild and customize your bike to your own tastes, choosing colors, decals and logos that you like.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/61bf1e8bf653eac33950ebc90829c68bd52fbefc.jpg
.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/8a3b09be77a7e447f7602d1470185747ef70b71a.jpg

NEW TRACK - REAH
Reah is the first of a series of space tracks designed to provide more extreme sensations. We started with an "easy" one, with bends and slopes. the next one will be in the same environment but feature loops and jumps.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/84319d9de298a1572bba21e272cb22201d2f7473.jpg
.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/f3ae860856d3c78935b6e6bb4b713ec51f80378f.jpg

PHOTO MODE UPDATES
We added the ability to tweak exposure and depth of field after taking a screenshot in the photo mode. Once you have captured your shot, you can now adjust exposure, focal distance, focal length and aperture using the thumbsticks. You can also point at a part of the image and press the trigger to set the focus. We also added more image fx to make your shots shine, including vignetting, chromatic aberration and grain. These effects are also present in the replays of your race.

Check out this little video tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9u7xBiap0Cg

VISUAL QUALITY TWEAKS
We revisited the tracks to add detail textures, improving the overall visual quality of the tracks. These details also help conveying the sensation of speed while racing. We tweaked the shaders on the bikes and the drivers to make them a bit sharper and shinier.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/1638d07fbebf4e7b2dfaeac6000d7ff5d8076a5a.jpg

MULTIPLAYER - SAVE THE DATE: Feb 23rd
You will see in the menus that we are planning a second test week-end for the multiplayer testing on feb 23rd. We've been holding multiplayer back for a while, because we were worried that the experience would be deceptive since the user base is still small. But some of you convinced us that we should just let go and release it, and we listened to them.
If you are into multiplayer, please join the discord channel so you can meet up with other players and synchronize to get online at the same time in your time zone and play.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/13073368da5ce8b6033e4d31b59037ed5b7641f8.png
https://discord.gg/JbN39jT

Enjoy

The Vertex Breakers Team

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER TEST IS ON !!
notes.content:
Hello racers,

We've just enabled the multiplayer feature on the main build for the weekend :-)
Relaunch Steam to force the game to update and you're good to go!

We've opened only one server for this weekend, on the US east coast. Everyone around the world will connect to that server.
It makes it easier to find other players when you connect, and it also helps us test the viability of playing across the ocean.
We've tried it already and we feel confident but only real world testing can confirm it.
Beyond this week-end, we plan to enable regional servers to improve ping and response time.

So, what we're testing this weekend is:
- can you connect?
- can you create or join a room?
- does voice support work properly?
- is the game playable in time trial and combat mode?
- are you having fun? ;-)

The best channel to connect with players, organize and give us feedback is discord: https://discord.gg/JbN39jT

We feel multiplayer really makes the game a lot more fun!
Thanks for helping us make this happen!

Have a great weekend

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: ARE YOU READY FOR MULTIPLAYER?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/feb94fc934e34d1e352fa13f630e69fcd3624f04.jpg

Hello racers,

Multiplayer, the big missing piece of V-Racer Hoverbike is coming!
We've recently run a few tests with friends and leaderboard superstar LittleBigMan, and it's shaping up very nicely.
Needless to say that combat races in multiplayer take the game to a whole new level!

We will roll out the feature in phases, starting with a first public test on the week-end of october 6th.

Can I participate?
Everyone will be able to join, but we need to organize: the VR community is still quite small (and V-Racer's community is of course even smaller).
In order to find other players to compete against, the best way is to schedule play session.
To help you connect with other players, we have set up a discord channel where everyone interested is invited to meet other players and schedule multiplayer races.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/13073368da5ce8b6033e4d31b59037ed5b7641f8.png
Join us on discord

I just can't wait!!!!
Well, join us on discord! We have an alpha ready, accessible on Steam with a code. We still need to tweak a few things, but we'd be happy to let you in earlier to help test.

How does it work?
In the game itself, it's simple as hell: just press the multiplayer button, and create a room. The room will automatically have your nickname on it so your friends can find it.
You can start to practice immediately in the room, even if you are alone, so there is no waiting. Whenever someone else joins, you will be taken back to the room config screen and can start a race together.
Other players who join while you are racing will be in spectator mode until the end of the race, when they can join the start line. Alternately, racers may choose to pause and quit the race to restart with newcomers.

Multiplayer offers both time trial and combat modes, on all tracks.

New weapons!
We have added a couple of new weapons to the mix: an eye gun that shoots in the direction you are looking at, and a killer drone that will chase the race leader to slow him down.
We also integrated player names on hoverbikes, a sneak preview of what's coming with the livery editor we are working on.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/d3615ea7a76f2b8fbf03a9277a631629906bbf77.jpg

See you soon in discord!
Join us on discord

The VertexBreakers team.

notes.title: WEEKLY CHALLENGE - NEW WEAPONS - NEW TRACKS - AND MORE….
notes.content:
Hello racers, here is what we have in this third update:

Weekly challenge
Starting now, we’ll have some weekly challenges for you! Each week, participate in a worldwide time trial on a selected track with turbos. We’ll post the winner’s race replay on our youtube and twitch channel. On the main game screen, you can access the week’s challenge, or see winners from previous weeks. Later on, we may consolidate the scores into an on-going championship leaderboard.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/da53f9f7caa9606965e43db18ed2f4a796d73c9e.jpg

New weapons
We added EMP to your weapon arsenal! Coming next is a killer drone, that you can send out to slow down the race leader.
We also added an energy bar to up the tension during combat races. You can now “eat” options with the left controller’s button to regain energy if required.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/a20ac010e811d3ffba1af9bebec363a3f2373ab2.jpg

More tracks
We added HPG Australia Circuit for simracers, and Kovas Prime Reverse for combat mode fans. You now have ten tracks to choose from. More tracks are in the works, and we are experimenting with bends and jumps for sensation hungry players.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/dfb66dcae0728081b4a82bf8cb636797cd46be64.jpg

News Feed on main screen
Steam community news are now displayed on the main screen, so you don’t have to go to the site to check out the latest posts about the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/f6d2f18775e78da561190004dfe273f80c812657.jpg

Various other tweaks…
We tuned the engine sound a little, added distorsion to get something closer to a bike engine, as requested by several of you.
We also added some shake effects to the bike when racing out of the track or getting hit by weapons.
There are also weapon icons on the HUD, providing visual feedback about which option you currently have.

Have fun!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: NEW TRACKS - PHOTO MODE - INCREASED SIM RATE - FREE RIDE MODE
notes.content:
Hello racers, here is what we have in this second update:

More tracks!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/08c4e4e6af283968da18f016c6182471f17b3aab.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/fcc1ca2c6e30e83e35bbefdcfe5a1e88a927beec.jpg
One of the top requests was to have more content in the game. So we’re starting to cover that with two brand new tracks: Kovas Prime is set on a desert planet and is great for arcade combat mode. It is more challenging than Vigo and Neopolis, with more slopes. HPG Malaysia Circuit is for simracers, based on the real Sepang track. We also added Vigo and Neopolis reverse tracks for those who are hungry enough. We have more tracks in the works coming in the next release!


In game photo mode
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/ceafd9ac8af0d616ce4e427156d4fc5a64cb94e7.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/bb91ccf93f93757ca9b5c66a8a34326e2046c7ad.jpg
Pause the game while racing or on the replay screen and you’ll be able to step into the scene, move around and take shots of the bikes and environment to share on your steam profile. These shots will also appear in the screen captures on the community hub. Remember we need to get the word out about the game, and screenshots help a lot. So let’s see how good you are at making these bikes look great! Share your best screenshots on the hub and vote for other players screenshots! We’ll also post the best ones on our facebook page regularly, with your steam nickname on them.


Simulation rate at 90FPS
We’ve upped the game simulation rate from 50FPS to 90FPS. Some players reported that although the rendering rate was 90FPS on their machines, it felt like the game was actually at 50FPS. It may be hard to notice for some, but increasing the simulation rate to match the rendering rate results in a smoother experience.

Free Ride game mode
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/704db7070a427ee0d0875470afd4ae7489ce6501.jpg
Some of you want to be able to race for 15 laps instead of 2 in time trial. Or to have turbos. Or not to have turbos in combat mode. We added a “free ride” mode that lets you choose exactly how you want to race: lap count, opponent count, turbos, weapons? You decide!

Localization
The game is now available in spanish and chinese. If you want it in yet another language and can help with translation, please contact us!

Next update is planned for end of may.

Have fun!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: WMR - Comfort Mode - UI with controllers - and more...
notes.content:
The first update is live on the beta branch! Right click on the game and select properties to switch to that branch if you want to test it, or just wait for a few days and it will be in the main release.

For this release we focused on fixing features based on the initial feedback that you provided, while the artists are hard at work on more tracks to complement existing ones. So here's what we've got in this update for you:

Comfort mode vs Extreme sensations
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/321f8c8064a3b4b45a0855d9a83b48cad5a640c9.gif
Some die hard drivers requested more sensations and commented that the tracks are too flat. We haven’t changed the tracks, but we added a comfort setting that lets you lean with the bike. By default, at 0%, the game doesn’t change. But the more you increase the setting towards 100%, the more you will lean with the bike as it turns. 100% means your head is “attached” to the bike and you get full leaning. This radically changes the perception and is not for the faint hearted as it increases the risk of motion sickness a lot. If you play with the slider, you will find what the best balance is for you between comfort and sensations. See more here: http://youtu.be/MDzOnn0AV0o

Windows Mixed Reality support
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/9d2112c4a93bae3463375c7f943f00e406302b79.gif
We've gotten our hands on a device and tested it thoroughly to ensure everything works for WMR users. We've integrated WMR controller models with help tips just like the Oculus/Vive. WMR users, if you find any bugs, let us know!

Controllers for UI
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/9224b714f589c7a63cd3158248480234f95a5968.gif
Many of you said we should make the UI work with controllers instead of GearVR style gazing. So we got rid of that, and from now on all the UI works with controllers (point and use the trigger to select, change pointing hand by squeezing the trigger).

Recenter
Also requested by several users, you can now reset your position when looking at the menus, if you want for instance to change orientation. Look at the tips on the controllers.

Ghost opponent count
One player suggested that in time trial, having too many ghosts could be confusing. You can now choose how many you want in the select track UI. Choose 0 if you want to race alone, and up to 5 opponents at once. These opponents are selected from the leaderboard around you (so if you switch the leaderboard to friends, you will only race against your friend's ghosts).

Localization
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/543235c3d13dc8cc04cff693099950192390a4fd.png
Besides english and french, this build is localized in german (Thanks Mike, who also translated the store page!). Spanish is coming next. More importantly, we've set up a system to easily localize it in other languages via a google spreadsheet, so if you want the game in your language and feel like helping with the translation, please PM me and I'll set you up for that.

Social Networks
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409831/dc9533cf794747e84fe2d1a3d7b36efa17116b6e.png
Ok, that feature wasn't requested by anyone, it's just us adding some "rate us" buttons in the UI. If you like the game, let the world know! We're not Electronic Arts, we don't have the required dollars to be in the front page of gaming sites, so let's use good ol' word of mouth on social networks, and that starts with ratings and sharing. If you're not into that, that's fine, just don't look at the bottom of the UI ;-)

Bug fix: music can now be turned off entirely.

Have fun!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: First update coming soon - Beta branch
notes.content:
Hello racers!

First of all we'd like to thank every player that joined the community during the launch this weekend. This has been a thrill for us to hear your first reactions to the game!

In order to deliver updates, we've set up an alpha and beta branch. Alpha is for our own testing, beta is for public testing. Every time we publish an update, we will push it to beta first, and migrate it to the release if you don't report any show stopper bugs in the discussion.

For those willing to play the beta branch, right click on the application in steam, select properties. The last tab on the right is where you select the branch you want to play on (right now you will only see the alpha branch, but the beta will show as soon as we post the first beta).

So the first update is coming in a few moments (need to feed the kids first ;-), stay tuned!
